chunks: So he left the city, fearful and hesitant, (and) prayed: "O Lord, deliver me from these wicked people."
ai.seo_question: What did the prophet pray when leaving his people?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir tradition, this verse is frequently interpreted as describing Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) exiting his people after their rejection, or alternatively, it is linked to the general state of the prophets' anxiety before divine intervention. The phrase 'yatarabbas' (watching/waiting) highlights the prophetic anticipation of Allah's promised punishment, serving as a spiritual model for believers to remain vigilant and supplicatory amidst societal oppression.
